pages.text: The Upgrade Template is required by the $(l:akaishi:upgrade_station)Upgrade Station$(/l): each level of a special ability consumes 1 template plus 20M energy and 1 upgrade slot on the gear.$(br2)Large quantities should be prepared before producing top-tier gear.

$(bold)Do not confuse it with the following upgrade items$(reset) (each has a distinct purpose):$(li)Red Machine Component / Akaishi Advanced Mechanism: shared machine crafting materials used by many recipes$(li)Energy Generation Upgrade: fits generator/matrix slots (max 10). Each level multiplies output by ×1.75 but reduces yield by 1%, total = 1.75^n × (1 - 0.01n)$(li)Machine Speed / Machine Energy Upgrade: fit the two upgrade slots of generic machines; each level gives +12.5% speed and +50% energy capacity, capped at 8$(br2)Templates upgrade gear; these items upgrade machines.

Template usage is described in $(l:akaishi:equipment)Equipment$(/l). Machine upgrade slots are shown in the $(l:akaishi:pulverizer)Pulverizer$(/l) and $(l:akaishi:transformer)Transformer$(/l) entries.
